description:
“We decided this should be our ‘going back to our roots’ album. Which is drums and vocals. Except for a bass line here and there, that is what it is. Drums and voice. Rhythms. We wanted the record to sound as intense as our live shows, and as chaotic as the world around us.”

The music of Rhythm is lean, hungry and defiant. In stripping back they have discovered an unblinking directness, a taut muscularity honed from years of intensive live performance.

Digital version includes bonus track 'Set It Free'

Watch the video to 'The Offbeat': http://youtu.be/0MdFprpSURw
